passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.description: Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by for seconds. Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds % of it's Mana cost.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.description: Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for seconds. Ally champions nearby gain Attack Range and restore Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every seconds. Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.description: Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting Shield and % Move Speed for seconds. This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring Health, and granting % Tenacity for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
